svg.title: Individual: one worker per plugin
svg.desc: plugin-hostd starts three workers, each holding one plugin: omx-comp, omx-delay, omx-drive. The sine source feeds the first, each feeds the next through JACK, the last feeds the playback ports. The daemon sits outside the JACK graph and only sends commands to the workers.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
